policy.resume_strategy: HTTP Range when supported; otherwise restart from byte zero

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources.notes: Download only when item metadata carries an explicitly accepted license.

sources.name: Europe PMC / PMC Open Access
sources.notes: OA subset only; package license checked before retrieval.

sources.name: Zenodo
sources.notes: Download only records with explicit CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA licenses; individual file and record metadata are retained.

sources.name: Directory of Open Access Books
sources.notes: Discovery candidate; add a reviewed adapter and verify book-level rights before downloads.

sources.name: Directory of Open Access Journals
sources.notes: Discovery candidate; journal/article licenses must be checked individually.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.notes: Use source-specific terms and verify reuse/redistribution rights before mirroring.
